summary: Today brings a mixed operational and legal briefing driven by appellate tribunal rulings on corporate insolvency and high-stakes retail performance metrics. Significant tribunal decisions from NCLAT and procedural oversight by the Delhi High Court accompany major capital deployment plans by Reliance and retail financial updates.

bullets.text: NCLAT rejected appeals filed by Yes Bank co-founder Rana Kapoor’s wife challenging insolvency proceedings against four companies.
Delhi High Court sought an explanation from a magistrate regarding a six-month delay in pronouncing an order.
Reliance unveiled plans to invest Rs 43,000 crore in an underground coal gasification project located in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh.
Titan issued an 11% margin guidance for its jewellery division, banking on stabilizing gold prices to drive retail demand.
Rentomojo reported a 63% decline in Q2 profit due to tax impacts, despite total income rising 53.1% to Rs 143.79 crore.
